title: Bounded long code value
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game with alphabet size $q$, let a finite randomized sign tester of query dimension $q$ be given, and assign to each vertex of $G$ a function from the $q$-dimensional Boolean cube to the signs. The bounded long code value is the uniform average over vertices of the tester's acceptance probability when its queries are answered using that vertex's bounded averaged neighbor function.
hypotheses_covered: A regular unique game G with alphabet size q
A finite randomized sign tester of query dimension q
A Boolean sign-valued function at each vertex
